meta.input: AIL test cases in src/test-cases/ with origin ail-2026
meta.note: Kept separate from test-case-wcag.json so the GOV.UK baseline coverage is unaffected.

colour-and-contrast-large-text-below-31-.title: Large text has a contrast ratio below 3:1 (AA)

wcag.rationale: 24px regular text (large text) at 2.52:1, below the 3:1 minimum for large text.
Below the 4.5:1 enhanced minimum for large text.

colour-and-contrast-large-text-below-451.title: Large text has a contrast ratio below 4.5:1 but at least 3:1 (AAA only)

wcag.rationale: 24px regular text at 3.41:1: passes 1.4.3 (3:1) but fails the 4.5:1 enhanced minimum for large text.

colour-and-contrast-small-text-below-71-.title: Small text has a contrast ratio below 7:1 but at least 4.5:1 (AAA only)

wcag.rationale: 16px text at 5.74:1: passes 1.4.3 (4.5:1) but fails the 7:1 enhanced minimum.

typography-blinking-text-cannot-be-pause.title: Blinking text cannot be paused, stopped or hidden

wcag.rationale: Text blinks indefinitely via CSS animation with no mechanism to pause, stop or hide it; F47 describes the same failure for the blink element.

tables-table-rows-have-different-numbers.title: Table rows have different numbers of cells

wcag.rationale: Rows with 3, 2 and 5 cells under 4 column headers make header-cell relationships ambiguous for assistive technology; HTML table model error rather than a listed WCAG failure technique (borderline).
Inline SVG star rating (4 of 5 stars) conveys information but has no role, <title>, aria-label or other text alternative.
An orientation media query rotates the content 90 degrees in landscape viewports, so it can only be read upright in portrait; orientation is not essential.

forms-invalid-autocomplete-value-on-pers.title: Invalid autocomplete value on personal data field

wcag.rationale: The field for the user's own email address has autocomplete="mail", which is not a valid token, so its purpose is not programmatically determinable.

forms-missing-autocomplete-on-personal-d.title: Missing autocomplete on personal data fields

wcag.rationale: Fields for the user's own name, email address and postcode have no autocomplete attribute or other means of identifying their purpose programmatically.

colour-and-contrast-form-field-border-ha.title: Form field border has insufficient contrast

wcag.rationale: The #dddddd border (1.36:1 against white) is the only visual boundary of the text inputs; 1.4.11 needs 3:1.

css-text-clipped-when-text-spacing-is-in.title: Text clipped when text spacing is increased

wcag.rationale: Fixed height of three lines at line-height 1.2 with overflow hidden; with line-height 1.5 the third line is cut off (measured in Chromium: content 72px in a 58px box).

keyboard-access-focus-removed-by-script-.title: Focus removed by script when received

wcag.rationale: The "Driving and transport" link calls blur() when it receives focus, so it cannot be activated from the keyboard.
The link never keeps focus, so no focus indicator is ever visible on it.
No focus indicator is ever shown on the link (AAA).
Receiving focus moves focus away from the component, a change of context on focus.

keyboard-access-single-character-key-sho.title: Single character key shortcut cannot be turned off

wcag.rationale: Pressing "s" (no modifier) outside a text field moves focus to the search field; the shortcut cannot be turned off or remapped and is active page-wide.

keyboard-access-positive-tabindex-scramb.title: Positive tabindex scrambles form focus order

wcag.rationale: Positive tabindex values make focus go postcode, address, town, name: the reverse of the visual and logical order of the address form.
In a scrolling panel, a sticky help footer entirely covers some links when keyboard focus scrolls them into view (measured in Chromium: "Universal Credit" and "Report a lost or stolen passport").
The same focused links are hidden entirely, so they are also not fully visible (AAA).

Slides change every 3 seconds indefinitely, start automatically and sit next to other content, with no pause, stop or hide mechanism. Auto-updating content; F16 (scrolling content) is close but not cited because the slides swap rather than scroll.

navigation-repeated-navigation-block-can.title: Repeated navigation block cannot be bypassed

wcag.rationale: Forty navigation links precede the content with no skip link, nav landmark or heading to jump past them; whether the block is repeated across pages is context not on the single page, and the fixture template wraps everything in <main> (borderline).

pointer-and-motion-path-gesture-required.title: Path gesture required without single pointer alternative

wcag.rationale: Slides change only with a horizontal swipe (or arrow keys); there is no single-pointer control such as previous/next buttons.
The Delete buttons remove the address on pointerdown, so the action cannot be aborted by moving away before release and there is no undo.

pointer-and-motion-drag-and-drop-without.title: Drag and drop without single pointer alternative

wcag.rationale: Items can be reordered only by dragging the handle (or arrow keys); clicking or tapping does nothing, so there is no single-pointer alternative.

forms-focus-on-field-opens-new-window-ai.title: Focus on field opens new window

wcag.rationale: Focusing the date field opens a new window, a change of context on focus (Understanding 3.2.1); verified in Chromium when focus arrives by Tab.
"Added to your basket" text is written into a plain paragraph after the button is pressed, with no status role or live region.
A role="checkbox" element toggles its visual tick by script but never sets aria-checked, so its state is not programmatically determinable.
The "Start now" link is inside aria-hidden="true" but stays in the tab order, so it receives focus with no exposed name or role (ACT rule 6cfa84).
The password field cancels paste events, so password managers and copy-paste cannot be used and the user must transcribe the password.
Same failure at AAA level.

multimedia-locally-flashing-animation-ab.title: Locally flashing animation above the general flash threshold

wcag.rationale: After the start button is selected, a 400 x 300 px area (larger than the 341 x 256 px small safe area) alternates between black and saturated red five times a second, above the general and red flash thresholds of three flashes per second.
The same area flashes more than three times in one second, whatever its size (AAA).
A silent 12-second video shows the four steps of repotting a plant as on-screen text and animation, with no text or audio alternative.

multimedia-prerecorded-video-without-aud.title: Prerecorded video without audio description or media alternative

wcag.rationale: The steps are only shown on screen; the soundtrack is music. There is no audio description and no media alternative.
No audio description of the on-screen steps (AA).
No full text alternative (AAA).

multimedia-audio-plays-automatically-wit.title: Audio plays automatically with no way to stop it

wcag.rationale: A 12-second looping music track starts automatically when the page loads, with no controls and no other way to pause, stop or change its volume.

images-decorative-image-with-non-empty-a.title: Decorative image with non-empty alt text

wcag.rationale: A purely decorative wavy line has alt="decorative border image", so screen readers announce it instead of ignoring it.

images-icon-font-conveys-meaning-without.title: Icon conveys meaning without text alternative (icon font pattern)

wcag.rationale: Only the CSS-drawn phone and fax icons on empty <i> elements (the icon-font pattern) say which number is for phone calls and which for fax; they have no text alternative.

images-image-of-text-used-for-a-heading-.title: Image of text used for a heading

wcag.rationale: The heading "Opening hours" is a PNG of bold serif text that CSS could produce; users cannot change its font, size, colour or spacing.
Image of text that is neither decoration nor essential (AAA).
role="presentation" on a data table removes its table, row and header semantics, so the relationships shown visually are not programmatically determinable.

tables-headers-attribute-references-wron.title: Headers attribute references wrong header ids

wcag.rationale: The headers attributes of every cell in the Child row point to the Adult row header and to the wrong fare columns, so assistive technology announces the wrong headers for those cells.

tables-layout-table-uses-th-and-caption-.title: Layout table uses th and caption

wcag.rationale: A table used only to place a start link beside a paragraph has a caption and a th cell, so it is announced as a data table with a header that has no tabular relationship.

content-table-formatted-with-spaces-in-p.title: Table formatted with spaces in preformatted text

wcag.rationale: Tabular data is laid out with spaces in a pre element, so rows, columns and headers are not programmatically determinable.
Read in source order the columns run together line by line, so the meaning of each value depends on its visual position.

content-spaces-used-to-spread-out-letter.title: Spaces used to spread out letters of a word

wcag.rationale: The heading "Welcome" is typed with spaces between its letters for visual effect, so it is read as separate letters rather than as a word.
The instructions identify the two buttons only by their shape ("round", "square"); the buttons have no visible text that the instructions refer to.
Only a tick symbol shows which sections are complete; there is no text that says so.
The ticks convey information (section complete) but are hidden from assistive technology and have no text alternative.
Specialised insurance terms (subrogation, indemnity, average clause, contributory negligence, pro rata) are used with no definition, glossary or explanation (AAA).
"Minute" can mean "very small" (my-NEWT) or refer to the minutes of a meeting (MIN-it); the meaning depends on the pronunciation, which is not given (AAA).

page-layout-message-asks-user-to-rotate-.title: Message asks user to rotate device

wcag.rationale: In a landscape viewport the content is hidden and only a message asking the user to rotate the device to portrait is shown.
At a width of 320 CSS px (and up to 30em) a media query hides the Weekends column, and the information is not available in any other way.

html-aria-list-role-without-listitem-chi.title: ARIA list role without listitem children

wcag.rationale: The container has role="list" but its children are plain div elements without role="listitem", so the list is exposed with no items.

html-page-regions-not-identified-with-la.title: Page regions not identified with landmarks

wcag.rationale: On the linked page the header, navigation, main content and footer are plain div elements, so the purpose of the regions cannot be programmatically determined (no landmarks; AAA).
The linked page has no skip link, landmarks or headings to bypass the navigation; whether the navigation repeats across pages is context not on the page (borderline).
The regions are visually distinct but not marked up; landmarks are one of several ways to meet 1.3.1 for page regions.

colour-and-contrast-text-over-background.title: Text over background image with insufficient contrast

wcag.rationale: White 20px text over a light sky background image with no overlay: about 1.1:1 to 1.3:1, far below 4.5:1.
Below the 7:1 enhanced minimum (AAA).
The only focus indicator is a light grey (#cccccc) outline on white, 1.61:1, below the 3:1 needed for a visual state of a component.
The focus indicator does not have a 3:1 contrast between focused and unfocused states (AAA).
A focus indicator is present, so focus is technically visible; its low contrast makes it hard to see.
The status icons (accepted, rejected) are the only visual indication of status and are light grey (#c0c0c0) on white, 1.81:1, below 3:1.

css-text-sized-only-in-viewport-units-ai.title: Text sized only in viewport units

wcag.rationale: The text is sized only with vw units (font-size: 1.5vw), so browser zoom does not make it larger; it gets smaller as the viewport narrows.

css-form-controls-do-not-resize-with-tex.title: Form controls do not resize with text

wcag.rationale: The labels are sized in em but the text inputs in px, so when only the text size is increased (browser font-size setting) the input text stays at 14px; page zoom enlarges both (borderline).
line-height, letter-spacing and word-spacing are set in style attributes with !important, so user styles cannot apply the 1.4.12 text spacing (ACT rules 24afc2, 78fd32, 9e45ec).

keyboard-access-tooltip-cannot-be-dismis.title: Tooltip cannot be dismissed with Escape

wcag.rationale: The tooltip that appears on hover or focus covers the paragraph below and can only be hidden by moving the pointer or focus away; Escape does not dismiss it.

keyboard-access-drawing-canvas-with-no-k.title: Drawing canvas with no keyboard alternative

wcag.rationale: The signature can only be drawn with a pointer; there is no keyboard way to sign, such as typing a name (AAA, no exception for path-dependent input).
Freehand signing depends on the path of movement, which is the exception in 2.1.1.

keyboard-access-sticky-header-partly-hid.title: Sticky header partly hides focused element

wcag.rationale: When focus moves back up the list (Shift+Tab), the focused link scrolls to the top of the panel and the sticky header covers its upper part (AAA).
The focused link is only partly hidden, so 2.4.11 (not entirely hidden) is met.
The button shows and hides a section but never sets aria-expanded, so its expanded or collapsed state is not exposed to assistive technology.

timing-page-refreshes-automatically-with.title: Page refreshes automatically with meta refresh

wcag.rationale: <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="30"> reloads the page every 30 seconds; the user cannot turn off, adjust or extend this time limit.
The automatic reload interrupts the user and cannot be postponed or suppressed (AAA).
The reload is a change of context that the user did not request (AAA).
<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="10; url=..."> redirects after 10 seconds; the user cannot turn off, adjust or extend this time limit.
The timed redirect interrupts the user and cannot be postponed or suppressed (AAA).
The redirect is a change of context that the user did not request (AAA).
Ten seconds after the page loads a non-urgent announcement is pushed into an alert, interrupting the user; there is no way to postpone or turn off such interruptions (AAA).
When the session ends after inactivity the answers are deleted, so after signing in again the user has to start over.
Nothing tells the user in advance how long a period of inactivity ends the session or that their answers will then be lost (AAA).
A warning 20 seconds before the end lets the user extend the session with one button, which meets 2.2.1.

timing-animation-triggered-by-scrolling-.title: Animation triggered by scrolling ignores reduced motion

wcag.rationale: Scrolling the panel moves and rotates a decorative block; the motion is not essential, ignores prefers-reduced-motion and cannot be turned off (AAA).

headings-headings-do-not-describe-their-.title: Headings do not describe their section

wcag.rationale: The headings "Section 1" and "More" do not describe the topic of the sections they introduce (renewing a passport, lost or stolen passports).
A long text covering several separate topics (who can apply, what you need, cost, how long it takes, using and renewing the badge) has no section headings (AAA).

forms-labels-do-not-describe-the-field-p.title: Labels do not describe the field purpose

wcag.rationale: The labels "Field 1" and "Field 2" do not describe what to enter (full name, email address).
Each field has a label, but the labels do not tell the user what input is expected (borderline).

forms-selecting-a-radio-button-opens-a-n.title: Selecting a radio button opens a new window

wcag.rationale: Choosing a radio option immediately opens a new window, a change of context on change of setting with no advance warning.

forms-form-submits-automatically-when-la.title: Form submits automatically when last field is filled

wcag.rationale: The form is submitted as soon as the fourth digit is typed, a change of context on input with no advance warning.

forms-financial-submission-without-revie.title: Financial submission without review or undo

wcag.rationale: Submitting the payment form takes the payment at once: there is no review step, no confirmation and, as the linked result page says, no way to cancel it.
The same submission is neither reversible, checked nor confirmed (AAA).

forms-no-context-sensitive-help-for-comp.title: No context-sensitive help for complex field

wcag.rationale: The field asks for a Unique Taxpayer Reference with no hint or help on what it is, its format or where to find it (AAA).
The field has a label; whether a format instruction is also needed depends on validation not shown on the page.
The message is sent as soon as the form is submitted, with no review or confirmation step and, as the linked page says, no way to withdraw it (AAA).
Step 2 (the linked page) asks for the billing address again with no "same as delivery address" option and no pre-filled values, although the address was entered in step 1.

navigation-only-one-way-to-find-pages-in.title: Only one way to find pages in a set

wcag.rationale: The three pages of the guide (linked) can only be reached through previous and next links; there is no menu, contents list, site map or search.

navigation-no-indication-of-location-wit.title: No indication of location within a set of pages

wcag.rationale: On the linked pages there is no breadcrumb, the menu does not mark the current page and the page titles do not name the set the page belongs to (AAA).
The main menu repeated on the three linked pages lists the same links, but in a different order on page 2.

navigation-same-function-labelled-differ.title: Same function labelled differently on different pages

wcag.rationale: The site search button has the same function on both linked pages but is labelled "Search" on one and "Find" on the other.

navigation-help-link-in-inconsistent-pla.title: Help in inconsistent place across pages

wcag.rationale: The housing team's contact details (a help mechanism) are at the top of page 1 but in the footer of page 2, so they are not in the same relative order.
Shaking the device clears the message; there is no button that does the same and no way to turn off the motion response.
The button responds to touch and keyboard but ignores mouse clicks, so a user cannot switch to a mouse on a touch device (AAA).

authentication-login-requires-transcribi.title: Login requires transcribing a code without paste

wcag.rationale: The one-time code is split over six fields that block paste and autofill (autocomplete="off"), so the user must transcribe it digit by digit.
Same failure at AAA level.

authentication-object-recognition-captch.title: Object recognition CAPTCHA as only option

wcag.rationale: Signing in requires either recognising objects in pictures or solving a word puzzle; both are cognitive function tests and there is no other method (AAA has no object-recognition exception).
The object-recognition option meets the 3.3.8 exception for recognising objects.

links-link-context-only-in-unrelated-con.title: Link context only in unrelated content

wcag.rationale: The link text "More" is in a paragraph of its own; the only text that explains it (buying a fishing licence) is in a later paragraph not associated with the link.
The link text alone does not identify its purpose (AAA).
